# t17.1 — Broker and worker health restored

## Summary

Rebuilt and restarted Kafka, producer, and consumer after t17 found only PostgreSQL and API running. Producer and consumer healthchecks now require both a recent event-loop heartbeat and reachable runtime dependencies; USGS source outages remain separate from worker liveness. All five Compose services report healthy, live USGS records are persisted, consumer offsets have zero lag, and the local health API responds successfully.

## Files Changed

- `compose.yaml` — use application-aware healthcheck commands for producer and consumer.
- `backend/producer/main.py` — start and clean up the producer event-loop heartbeat.
- `backend/consumer/main.py` — start and clean up the consumer event-loop heartbeat after dependencies initialize.
- `backend/scripts/worker_health.py` — atomic heartbeat and dependency-probe implementation.
- `backend/scripts/worker_healthcheck.py` — Docker healthcheck command-line entrypoint.
- `backend/tests/test_worker_health.py` — tests for fresh/stale heartbeat and dependency failure behavior.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t17.1-devops.md` — this task report.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/team/devops/log.md` — devops session log entry.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/learnings/devops/compose-kafka-runtime.md` — worker-health convention for future Compose work.

At task start, `almacenamiento` and `api` were healthy; `broker` had exited with 143, `consumidor` with 137, and no producer container was present. The reason for those prior stops is not established by the available evidence.

## Evidence Mapping

- `t3.1-teamlead.md#Canonical Service Matrix` and `#Startup, Failure, and Recovery Semantics` → `worker_health.py`, `worker_healthcheck.py`, and `compose.yaml`: an event-loop heartbeat is refreshed every 10 seconds, expires after 45 seconds, and is combined with broker reachability (plus PostgreSQL for the consumer). `USGS` reachability is intentionally not a worker-liveness dependency.
- `t8-devops.md#Evidence Mapping` and `.agents/rules/architecture_invariants.md#1-2` → rendered Compose configuration: exactly five canonical services, healthchecks on all five, no host ports for Kafka/PostgreSQL, and API bound to `127.0.0.1:8000`.
- `t9-backend.md#Live Producer` and `t12-backend.md#Processing and Naming Decisions` → producer/consumer startup probes plus runtime: live events persisted and consumer group caught up at zero lag.
- `t16-backend.md#Replay` → broker retains both canonical topic layouts; live processing continues while the replay partition remains independent.
- `t17-frontend.md#Handoff / Risks` → all five services are healthy after recovery; the local health endpoint and live pipeline respond.

## Test Results

- Command: `docker compose --env-file .env.example run --build --rm --no-deps productor python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_usgs_live_producer.py -v`
  - Passed: 9; Failed: 0; Skipped: 0; exit code: 0.
- Command: `docker compose --env-file .env.example run --build --rm --no-deps consumidor python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_consumer_*.py" -v`
  - Passed: 27; Failed: 0; Skipped: 5; exit code: 0. The skipped tests are the suite's opt-in database integration cases.
- Command: `docker compose --env-file .env.example run --build --rm --no-deps consumidor python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_worker_health.py -v`
  - Passed: 3; Failed: 0; Skipped: 0; exit code: 0.
- Command: `docker compose --env-file .env.example up --build -d broker productor consumidor`
  - Passed: producer and consumer images built; broker, producer, and consumer started after required dependencies were healthy; exit code: 0.
- Command: `docker compose --env-file .env.example config --quiet` plus structural assertions on rendered Compose JSON
  - Passed: exact five-service set; all five healthchecks; Kafka/PostgreSQL unpublished; API loopback-only; exit code: 0.
- Runtime probes: `docker compose ps` reported all five services `running / healthy`; each worker healthcheck CLI reported “worker heartbeat and dependencies are ready”; `GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health` returned HTTP 200 with database status `ok`.
- Live pipeline evidence: PostgreSQL contained 273 current events; `observatorio-consumer-group` lag was 0 on all three live partitions and the replay partition.
- Kafka topics remained `earthquakes.live` (3 partitions) and `earthquakes.replay` (1 partition), each with 172,800,000 ms retention.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

## Handoff / Issues

- Compose services are left running and healthy for downstream dashboard and acceptance-test tasks.
- Five opt-in consumer database integration tests were skipped by the default unit command; this task did not rerun them.
- No Kafka/PostgreSQL host ports, secrets, or public deployment configuration were added.
